👨‍👩‍👧 Budget 2027 — what it means for families:

• Income tax cut 1 percentage point
• General relief up from RM9,000 to RM12,000
• STR cash aid to ~RM16 billion, plus SARA up to RM150/month
• Service tax on elderly care cut 8% → 6%

Full, sourced breakdown 👉

#Malaysia #Budget2027 #CostOfLiving

💼 Budget 2027 for workers:

• Minimum wage rises RM1,700 → RM2,000 (from June 2027)
• A RM2,500 floor for graduates and semi-skilled workers
• Automatic EPF registration at age 18
• EPF matching of up to RM600/year for gig workers

What changes, and when 👉

#Malaysia #Budget2027 #Wages #EPF

🏢 Budget 2027 for SMEs and business:

• SME income tax cut by 1 percentage point
• Small-value asset write-off threshold up to RM3,000/asset
• Manufacturers can reclaim sales tax on machinery
• Stamp-duty exemption on opening bank accounts (1 Jan 2027)

The business breakdown 👉

#Malaysia #Budget2027 #SME

⚖️ A reminder on Budget 2027: these measures are ANNOUNCED, not yet law.

They take effect through the Finance Bill, the Supply (Budget) 2027 Act and gazette orders — on the dates stated in the speech. We track each one from "announced" to "in force," every claim sourced.

Stay accurate 👉

#Malaysia #Budget2027
